title: AliExpress reviews
description: Three row types share one dataset: review (one buyer review, charged), product (context and rating statistics for a product, free) and status (one per target, free).

dataset.title: AliExpress reviews
dataset.description: One row per buyer review, plus per-product context and status rows. Charged rows are billed as delivered; product and status rows are always free.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: One JSON record with the counts this run delivered and charged, its error, duplicate and repeat tallies, and its HTTP stats.
